about.title: About Portuguese Learning
about.subtitle: Your interactive platform to master Portuguese
about.purposeText: Portuguese Learning is an interactive web application designed to help you master the Portuguese language through engaging challenges and exercises. Whether you speak French or English, our platform adapts to your native language to provide the best learning experience.
about.languagesText: Our platform supports learners who speak French or English. Simply select your preferred language, and all translations, instructions, and explanations will be tailored to help you understand Portuguese concepts in the language you're most comfortable with.
about.wordChallengeText: Build your Portuguese vocabulary by translating words from your native language. Perfect for expanding your everyday vocabulary.
about.verbChallengeText: Master Portuguese verb conjugations in the present tense. Practice with different pronouns and learn proper verb forms.
about.idiomChallengeText: Learn authentic Portuguese expressions and idioms that native speakers use in everyday conversations.
about.guestAccountText: Start learning immediately without registration! Guest accounts allow you to try all features and save your progress for 7 days. Perfect for exploring the platform before committing to an account.
about.guestAccountFeatures: Access to all challenges, temporary progress tracking, 7-day expiration, no email required.
about.registeredAccountText: Create a free account to permanently save your progress and unlock personalized learning features. Your data is securely stored and accessible from any device.
about.registeredAccountFeatures: Permanent progress tracking, personalized challenges based on weak areas, detailed statistics and analytics, progress saved forever.
about.upgradeAnytime: You can upgrade from a guest account to a registered account at any time, and all your progress will be preserved!
about.getStartedText: Choose your learning mode and start mastering Portuguese today!
about.personalProjectText: This website was built by me as a personal project to help me learn Portuguese from French. It is not a professional service, and I'm continuously improving it. As I add new features and make upgrades, there may occasionally be brief outages or disruptions.
about.personalProjectNote: Thank you for your understanding and patience as I work to make this learning tool better!
about.openSourceText: This project is open source and serves as both a learning tool for Portuguese and an opportunity for me to explore coding with AI assistance. The entire source code is available on GitHub.
about.githubStar: ⭐ Star the repository to show your support and appreciation!
about.githubIssues: 🐛 Found a bug or have an improvement idea? Open an issue on GitHub - your feedback is valuable!
